skill-catalog.title: Shared skills
skill-catalog.intro: Organization-reviewed skills, pinned to published project revisions. Search by domain, scenario or keyword.
skill-catalog.approval_boundaries: Organization sharing and target-project adoption are separate approvals. Adoption creates a draft; it never publishes or dispatches work automatically.
skill-catalog.empty_hint: Adjust the filters, or have an authorized administrator share a published project skill.
skill-catalog.eligibility.current: Current approved source; available for authorized adoption.
skill-catalog.eligibility.source_changed: The source has changed or is no longer eligible. This approved text remains readable, but new adoption is blocked until the catalog is reviewed and updated.
skill-catalog.eligibility.publication_ch: A newer catalog version exists. This historical version remains readable; read and review the current version before any new adoption or change.
skill-catalog.eligibility.retired: Retired. History remains readable; new adoption is blocked.
skill-catalog.historical: You are reading an immutable historical version. Return to the current version before making a change or adopting it.
skill-catalog.no_permissions: Skill text is context. It does not install plugins, execute scripts or grant tool permissions.
skill-catalog.origin_boundary: Only the approved skill body is shared. Original source quotations and private source records are not included.
skill-catalog.selection_hint: Review the approved text, source version and current eligibility before adopting it.
skill-catalog.sharing_hint: Organization approval shares the selected published body with this organization's authorized project readers. Review its content and metadata explicitly.
skill-catalog.adoption_hint: Project approval creates an independent skill draft in the current project. Review and publish it through the existing project knowledge process before use. Future catalog changes do not overwrite it.
skill-catalog.retirement_hint: Retirement blocks new adoption and preserves approved text, history and existing project copies.
skill-catalog.no_sources: No eligible published skill is in this loaded page. Create and approve a project skill first, or load more.
skill-catalog.draft_does_not_replace: A newer project draft exists. Sharing still pins the published revision; the draft does not replace it.
skill-catalog.source_unavailable: This source no longer has an eligible current publication. Read and review its latest state before sharing.
skill-catalog.review_shared_text: Review the exact body to be shared
skill-catalog.domain_hint: For example, engineering standards, quality or operations.
skill-catalog.scenarios_hint: Separate with commas; up to 8 scenarios.
skill-catalog.reason_hint: Briefly explain the basis for this sharing or adoption.
skill-catalog.sharing_ack: I approve sharing this exact published skill body and these metadata values within the organization. This does not share original source records or add execution permissions.
skill-catalog.adoption_ack: I approve creating this fixed catalog version as a draft in the current project. It requires a separate project publication and will not change existing tasks or runs.
skill-catalog.recovery_hint: Recover the same saved request before another change. Its original project, source revision, metadata, approval and operation key are retained.
skill-catalog.saved: Catalog change confirmed. Refreshing the current version.
skill-catalog.adopted: Project skill draft created. It is not published or active yet.
skill-catalog.invalid_read: The shared skill response does not match the expected current scope or contract.
skill-catalog.refresh_failed: Current catalog or source facts could not be read. Your draft is retained.
skill-catalog.access_changed: Current authority or source eligibility no longer permits this operation. Review the current version.
skill-catalog.share_link: Review sharing in the organization catalog
skill-catalog.sharing_unavailable: Organization sharing requires current organization and source-project approval authority. No skill has been shared.
skill-catalog.adoption_lineage_hint: This is an independent project copy. Later catalog changes do not overwrite it; project publication remains a separate approval.
